response.sql: SELECT t.riskeval AS status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY t.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: A zero-minute scan has no defined file size per minute, so it is excluded from the average.
